charles-e-sorensen.l0_summary: Executive head of Ford manufacturing; architect of Highland Park assembly line and Willow Run B-24 Bomber Plant.

willow-run-bomber-plant.l0_summary: Ford mass-production aircraft facility manufacturing B-24 Liberator bombers using moving assembly line techniques.

cesor-corporation.l0_summary: Entity managing Sorensen Cuban agricultural and plantation assets subject to 1960 nationalization claims.

willys-overland-motors.l0_summary: Post-war automotive company where Sorensen served as President/Vice Chairman, developing civilian Jeep lines.

harry-bennett.l0_summary: Head of Ford Service Department; key antagonist in Ford executive politics against Edsel Ford and Sorensen.

helene-estate.l0_summary: Sorensen Miami Beach residence and luxury yachts (Helene I & II) utilized during retirement and Florida operations.
